models.name: stg_billing__customers
models.grain: One row per live billing customer.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: The billing system's customer ID, as written.

columns.name: email
columns.description: The customer's billing email address, in lower case without surrounding spaces.

columns.name: contact_name
columns.description: The contact's name.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: The customer's billing currency code.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: When the customer was created, from Unix seconds, in UTC.

exclusions.name: test_mode
exclusions.reason: Customers created in test mode are not real.

models.name: stg_billing__invoices
models.grain: One row per live invoice, including void and open invoices and refunds.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: The billing system's invoice ID.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: The customer the invoice is for.

columns.name: amount_minor
columns.description: The amount in the currency's smallest unit, as an integer; refunds are negative.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: The invoice's currency code.

columns.name: status
columns.description: paid, open or void.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: When the invoice was created, from Unix seconds, in UTC.

exclusions.name: test_mode
exclusions.reason: Invoices created in test mode are not real.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The CRM account ID, kept as text so its leading zeros stay.

columns.name: company_name
columns.description: The company's name.

columns.name: billing_email
columns.description: The account's billing email address, in lower case without surrounding spaces.

columns.name: segment
columns.description: enterprise, mid_market or smb.

columns.name: status
columns.description: customer or prospect.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: When the account was created, read as day/month/year.

models.name: stg_events__events
models.grain: One row per product event, each delivered event once.

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: The event's ID.

columns.name: workspace_id
columns.description: The workspace the event happened in.

columns.name: user_email
columns.description: The user's email address, as delivered.

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: What happened.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.description: When the event happened, in UTC.

exclusions.name: repeat_deliveries
exclusions.reason: The event log sometimes delivers the same event more than once, as an exact copy.

models.name: int_customers_matched_to_accounts
models.grain: One row per live billing customer, with the CRM account of the same company.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: The billing customer.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The CRM account whose billing email has the same domain as the customer's email; empty when the company has no CRM account.

exclusions.name: test_mode
exclusions.reason: Customers created in test mode are not real.

assumptions: The email domain identifies the company in both systems; some CRM accounts hold another mailbox at the company's domain.
